own_solution.law: Static equilibrium with Archimedes' principle: T = (rho_liquid - rho_cube) V g, V = a^3
assumptions: cube fully submerged and at rest (stated)

T1C10.regime: string intact: required tension (3.92 N) at or below the 50 N limit

TCDB2.regime: string intact: required tension (3.92 N) at or below the 50 N limit

notes: V = 0.1^3 = 1.0e-3 m^3. Buoyancy 1000*1e-3*9.8 = 9.8 N, weight 600*1e-3*9.8 = 5.88 N, T = 3.92 N. With 1250 kg/m^3 in the tank: buoyancy 12.25 N, T = 6.37 N. Depth of the top face enters the pressures on the top and bottom faces (p0 + rho g d and p0 + rho g (d + a)) but cancels in their difference, so it is C. The 50 N string rating matters only if the required tension exceeded 50 N; 3.92 N (and 6.37 N) is well within it, so K. Liquids on another bench or in a sealed bottle are D. Paired sentences state the same value and unit (1250 kg/m^3; 50 cm; 50 N) and differ only in wording/attachment.
